scene_description: Two girls are in a kitchen decorating Halloween cupcakes and cookies. There are ghost-shaped treats, pumpkin cookies, frosting in a green bowl, and jack-o'-lanterns in the background. One girl is spreading frosting on a cupcake while the other works on cookies.

questions.question: What are the girls decorating?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the food on the table in front of the girls.

questions.question: What is the girl in green doing with the cupcake?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girl on the right and what she is holding.

questions.question: Where are the girls making their treats?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the room around the girls — the stove, tiles, and counter.

questions.question: What Halloween decorations do you see in the background?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the girls on the counter in the back of the kitchen.

questions.question: How do the girls look while they are decorating?
sample_answers: they look like they are having fun
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the girls' faces — what do you notice?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever decorated a cupcake or cookie? What did you put on it?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you decorated food or helped in the kitchen.
